races.name: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A match on paper between GINOLO and Mysterland, with marginal preference for the former who pulled clear with a promising sort on debut at Worcester last month. Charlie Longsdon's charge showed a good attitude to get off the mark at Sedgefield last month and he won't allow the selection to have it all his own way.

  1. GINOLO (IRE)
  2. MYSTERLAND (FR)
  3. AR AGHAIDH LEAT (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CADILLAC RANCH is relatively unexposed for one at this level and has built up a good rapport with his amateur rider. He gets the nod over Market House, who looks to have solid claims under Alex Chadwick, with Prairie Diamond and Rip Wheeler also worth considering in a tricky betting heat.

  1. CADILLAC RANCH (IRE)
  2. MARKET HOUSE (IRE)
  3. PRAIRIE DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: John Weight Gone But Not Forgotten Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CREST OF STARS made a promising start to his chasing career over C&D 11 days ago and expected to build on that, he looks the way to go. Icare Grandchamp's record fresh is a positive one so he's feared as a previous C&D winner, while Clap of Thunder and Ionian also have something to recommend them.

  1. CREST OF STARS (IRE)
  2. ICARE GRANDCHAMP (FR)
  3. CLAP OF THUNDER (IRE)

races.name: 'Anyone Want A Drink? Anyone?' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KAMILLE AU KANADA may well be headed for better things so a 4-timer looks likely. Last-time-out winners Norman Fletcher and Tune In A Box are the likely dangers off unchanged marks.

  1. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR)
  2. NORMAN FLETCHER
  3. TUNE IN A BOX (IRE)

races.name: More Radio Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
In a weak race, EPHYRA is chanced from a mark that looks workable on last season’s course second given she should be sharper for her recent return. In-form chase winner Golly Gosh is feared most despite stamina concerns at this longer trip, with Anothermanicmonday also respected.

  1. EPHYRA
  2. GOLLY GOSH (IRE)
  3. ANOTHERMANICMONDAY (IRE)

races.name: Docker Hughes Memorial Race Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
UNCLE AL jumped better than usual when routing Daring Plan at Fontwell last time and looks capable of confirming that superiority despite meeting that rival on 5 lb worse terms, even if Susan Gardner’s charge should get closer. Back It Up is hard to weigh up but could improve for the fitting of a visor.

  1. UNCLE AL (IRE)
  2. DARING PLAN (IRE)
  3. BACK IT UP (IRE)

races.name: Neville Hall 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SIR EDWARD LEAR left previous efforts over hurdles behind when fourth at Huntingdon recently and capable of better again now handicapping, James Owen's 5-y-o gets the verdict. Bobbi's Beauty hasn't been seen in this sphere since spring 2024 but arriving on the back of a recent win over fences, she's put forward as the main threat. Kotari looks best of the rest.

  1. SIR EDWARD LEAR
  2. BOBBI'S BEAUTY (IRE)
  3. KOTARI (FR)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict:
GO GO GIRL looks to have plenty in her favour, and she's fancied to make a winning start in nurseries. Lord Ragnar is feared most back in calmer waters, with Big Hitter, Roosike and Time Teller also respected.

  1. GO GO GIRL
  2. LORD RAGNAR (IRE)
  3. BIG HITTER (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DESERT ROMANCE is yet to live up to her illustrious pedigree but there's been obvious signs of ability on both starts and switched to all-weather, she can get on the up. Threelittleangels should be a factor again, with Tootgarook perhaps the pick of the debutantes.

  1. DESERT ROMANCE
  2. THREELITTLEANGELS (IRE)
  3. TOOTGAROOK (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LEADING ROLE looked a useful prospect when bolting up at Nottingham last month and with improvement on the cards, Charlie Appleby's colt will prove a tough nut to crack. John & Thady Gosden look to have a couple of live contenders and newcomer Ever Since shades the vote over Afif for the forecast spot.

  1. LEADING ROLE
  2. EVER SINCE (AUS)
  3. AFIF (FR)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
AL LAHBAB made his odds-on stablemate work hard on debut at Newmarket last month so with improvement on the cards, Charlie Appleby's colt is strongly fancied to go a place better. Kings Medal offered something to work on before tiring late on at Southwell recently so he can offer most resistance, with debutants Adventus Saxonum and Simply George taken to fight out third.

  1. AL LAHBAB
  2. KINGS MEDAL
  3. ADVENTUS SAXONUM

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
Potential for a burn-up here. RHYTHM N HOOVES is handicapped to win again if things fall right. There could still be some mileage in Law of Average's mark, too, with Atomic Force, Knebworth and Tan Rapido likely players if this sets up for the closers.

  1. RHYTHM N HOOVES
  2. LAW OF AVERAGE
  3. ATOMIC FORCE (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
NEWSREADER arrives in form and is selected to snap a lengthy losing run, with his good draw and tactical versatility offering insurance against a possible lack of pace; Intervention is feared most as a well-handicapped multiple course winner, though his wide draw complicates matters, while in-form veteran Split Elevens is also expected to be involved in the outcome.

  1. NEWSREADER (IRE)
  2. INTERVENTION
  3. SPLIT ELEVENS

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
R P MCMURPHY could be set for a fifth course victory. Criminal Shore is feared most off a handy mark. In-form pair Yehudi and Danehill Star also need a look in a competitive event.

  1. R P MCMURPHY
  2. CRIMINAL SHORE (IRE)
  3. YEHUDI (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
TED LE SAUX is relatively unexposed and shaped well over C&D last time. He's fancied to double his tally for the Andrew Balding yard, with Cancan In The Rain and Paladin appealing as each-way options in an open-looking handicap.

  1. TED LE SAUX
  2. CANCAN IN THE RAIN (IRE)
  3. PALADIN (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
SAXOPHONIC is fast developing into a course specialist and looks primed to follow up his recent C&D win, with a 4 lb rise offset by the booking of an apprentice who knows him well. Havachoc should again be in the mix after bouncing back behind the selection last time, with Tiger Beetle respected back up in trip after scoring here last month.

  1. SAXOPHONIC
  2. HAVACHOC
  3. TIGER BEETLE
